item.title: Storage facility raided as feds investigate alleged ISIS-inspired NYC bomb throwers
item.summary: Federal investigation underway after Pennsylvania students accused of explosive attack outside mayor's residence. ISIS inspiration concerns cited.

item.title: Cannabis compounds could reverse disease affecting one-third of adults
item.summary: Compounds found in cannabis could provide a new roadmap for treating the world’s most common chronic liver disorder, according to a study released by the Hebrew University of Jerusalem.

item.title: Trump, Thune clash on voter ID ultimatum as GOP remains divided on path forward
item.summary: Senate Republicans are still divided on using the talking filibuster for voter ID legislation as Senate Democrats vow to block the bill.

item.title: Katie Britt blasts Democrats for playing 'political games' with shutdown amid airport chaos
item.summary: Senate Democrats threatened to freeze legislative business over Trump's Iran war powers as the partial DHS shutdown entered its fourth week.

item.title: 5 Iranian women's soccer players receive asylum in Australia after Trump pressure
item.summary: At least five Iranian women's soccer players were granted asylum in Australia after the country received added pressure from President Donald Trump on Monday.

item.title: Biden-appointed judge in the hot seat after DHS fires back at 'false' claims about ICE facility
item.summary: The Biden-tapped federal judge ruled that detainees were 'stuffed into unclean cells’ at an ICE holding center in Baltimore, and ordered substantive changes, prompting backlash from DHS.

item.title: ‘90 Day Fiancé’ alum's boyfriend on trial for attempted murder over wild ‘Boca Bash’ accusations
item.summary: "90 Day Fiancé" star's boyfriend accused of trying to drown her during boat fight. Cole Goldberg faces murder trial after the alleged violent attack.

item.title: Virginia Dems send Spanberger bill that could let some repeat offenders out without secured bond, expert warns
item.summary: Bail industry leader warns Virginia's HB 357 threatens public safety by removing bond requirements for repeat felons. Critics say bill eases jail release.

item.title: Tarik Skubal leaves Team USA to return to Tigers camp despite mixed feelings after successful start
item.summary: Tarik Skubal will make just one Team USA start after all, as manager Mark DeRosa announced he will return to the Detroit Tigers despite second thoughts.

item.title: 40+ House Republicans rally behind Markwayne Mullin for DHS, call it a ‘critical moment’ for border security
item.summary: In a letter to President Trump, members of the Republican Main Street Caucus back Sen. Markwayne Mullin to lead Homeland Security after Kristi Noem's ouster.
